descriptionMarkdown:
Scalable blueprints for balanced science production. Simply hookup the input lines to the relevant materials marked by the display panels.

Each blueprint adds to the previous one for easy science scaling.

Fully upgradable using the levels below. Upgrade planners included in book.
Level 1: Assembly machine 1, yellow belts, inserters. Produces 0.5/s (30/min) science
Level 2: Assembly machine 2, fast inserters. Produces 0.75/s (45/min) science
Level 3: Red belts
Level 4: Assembly machine 3, blue belts.  Produces 1.25/s (75/min) science
Level 3/4R: Roboports, lights

See details inside each book for accurate materials required to run at full capacity.
title: Fully Scalable Science Production
